title: An etale algebra over a normal ring is a normal ring
statement: Let $A\to B$ be a homomorphism of commutative rings such that $\operatorname{Spec}B\to\operatorname{Spec}A$ is etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]. If $A$ is a normal ring [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring], then $B$ is a normal ring.

source.place: Stacks Project, Algebra, Lemma Tag 033C (lemma-normal-goes-up: R -> S smooth, R normal => S normal), applied to an etale ring map, which is standard smooth (Lemma Tag 00U9, lemma-etale-standard-smooth) hence smooth; Morphisms, Lemma Tag 02GJ (2) for Spec B -> Spec A etale => A -> B etale. Used in More on Algebra, Lemma Tag 06DI.
